name: citylit
description: A mobile-first 3D discovery game for South African cities

scripts.build: node scripts/export-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/export-ui-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-pwa.mjs && next build
scripts.lint: oxlint app components lib tests next.config.ts proxy.ts playwright.config.ts scripts/export-brand-assets.mjs scripts/export-ui-icons.mjs scripts/build-pwa.mjs public/offline.js public/sw.js public/theme.js scripts/check-production.mjs scripts/tests/production.test.mjs scripts/compress-stage-models.mjs scripts/audit-stage-models.mjs scripts/compress-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-site-informed-models.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt app components lib tests next.config.ts proxy.ts playwright.config.ts .github .coderabbit.yaml vercel.json scripts/export-brand-assets.mjs scripts/export-ui-icons.mjs scripts/build-pwa.mjs public/offline.js public/sw.js public/theme.js public/offline.css public/theme.css scripts/check-production.mjs scripts/tests/production.test.mjs scripts/compress-stage-models.mjs scripts/audit-stage-models.mjs scripts/compress-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-site-informed-models.mjs
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --write tests/all-3d-landmarks.spec.ts lib/landmark-exploded-view.js && git diff -- tests/all-3d-landmarks.spec.ts lib/landmark-exploded-view.js && oxfmt --check app components lib tests next.config.ts proxy.ts playwright.config.ts .github .coderabbit.yaml vercel.json scripts/export-brand-assets.mjs scripts/export-ui-icons.mjs scripts/build-pwa.mjs public/offline.js public/sw.js public/theme.js public/offline.css public/theme.css scripts/check-production.mjs scripts/tests/production.test.mjs scripts/compress-stage-models.mjs scripts/audit-stage-models.mjs scripts/compress-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-museum-hero.mjs scripts/audit-site-informed-models.mjs
scripts.models:build: python3 scripts/prepare-stage-scans.py && blender --background --python-exit-code 1 --python scripts/build-landmark-models.py && node scripts/compress-stage-models.mjs
scripts.models:audit: node scripts/audit-stage-models.mjs && node scripts/audit-museum-hero.mjs && node scripts/audit-site-informed-models.mjs && node scripts/audit-recessed-architecture.mjs
scripts.hero:build: python3 scripts/fetch-museum-pbr.py && blender --background --python-exit-code 1 --python scripts/build-museum-hero.py && node scripts/compress-museum-hero.mjs
